fact: The director of the Cadastre said at the Journees foncieres (5-7 October 2026) that the tax administration's e-Cadastre platform is contributing to the progressive dematerialisation of cadastre procedures.
The finance ministry says the Livre Foncier Electronique (LIFE) is an application letting notaries consult land titles online.
The finance ministry says notaries can consult land titles online through LIFE, with access to be extended to banks and others in the land chain.
